name: 03 - Content Maker - Native Gemini + Postgres Memory

parameters.query: select b.blueprint, m.business_profile, m.audience_profile, m.offer_profile, m.brand_profile, m.creation_preferences, m.memory_summary, c.title as saved_title, c.brief as saved_brief, c.slides as saved_slides, c.messages as saved_messages, c.theme as saved_theme, coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('file_name', a.file_name, 'asset_role', a.asset_role, 'mime_type', a.mime_type, 'palette', a.palette) order by a.created_at desc) from public.workspace_assets a where a.owner_id = $2::uuid), '[]'::json) as assets from (select $2::uuid as owner_id) u left join public.blueprint_sessions b on b.owner_id = u.owner_id and b.session_id = nullif($1, '')::uuid left join public.workspace_memory m on m.owner_id = u.owner_id left join public.content_sessions c on c.project_id = $3::uuid and c.owner_id = u.owner_id limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.session_id, $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.user_id, $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.project_id ] }}

options.systemMessage: You are Astro, an expert creation strategist connected to Avatar IQ and Offer IQ. Account memory, the buyer blueprint, the offer, uploaded briefs, logos, and brand colors are authoritative. For generate mode, create exactly the requested number of slides (1 to 90). Keep one idea per slide, no more than 4 concise bullets, speaker-ready copy, and valid slide types. Return only the structured output requested by the parser.

parameters.sessionKey: ={{ $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.user_id + ':content:' + $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.project_id }}

parameters.query: insert into public.content_sessions (project_id, owner_id, blueprint_session_id, status, title, brief, slides, messages, theme, last_error, updated_at) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, nullif($3, '')::uuid, 'completed', $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, null, now()) on conflict (owner_id, project_id) do update set blueprint_session_id = excluded.blueprint_session_id, status = 'completed', title = excluded.title, brief = excluded.brief, slides = excluded.slides, messages = excluded.messages, theme = excluded.theme, last_error = null, updated_at = now() returning project_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.project_id, $json.user_id, $json.session_id, $json.title, JSON.stringify({ description: $json.description, purpose: $json.result?.purpose, slide_count: $json.result?.slideCount }), JSON.stringify($json.result?.slides ?? []), JSON.stringify($json.messages), JSON.stringify({ style: $json.result?.style, font_set: $json.result?.fontSet, palette: $json.result?.palette, ratio: $json.result?.ratio }) ] }}
